Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace product page — copy & co-sell checklist

Hi Irene (and Jonas),

Thanks again for the introduction last week. Attached is our current draft for the product page copy and the hero/CTA options — we pulled it together with our marketing team to focus on acquisition and co-sell follow-through. High-level asks from our side: 

- Can Redwood suggest a headline variant that prioritizes conversion (trial signups) while staying accurate on capability claims?
- Any required / recommended language for AWS procurement and privateoffers (trial duration, SKU labels, AMI disclaimers)?
- Anything on the page that would block AWS co-sell ops (evidence, SLAs, seller registration items)?

We'd love a quick review and a 30-min sync next week to walk through edits and to align on a joint go-to-market snippet. I included Jonas since he’s coordinating the partner enablement.

Attachment: Acme_Retail_Redwood_ProductPage_Draft_v2.docx (product page draft, hero options, sample screenshots)

Best,
Maya Patel
Product Lead — Acme Retail
maya@acmeretail.com
+1 (206) 555-0147

Note: We are under a tight Q3 launch timeline — aiming to publish tentatively the week of Aug 2.
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace product page — copy & co-sell checklist

Hi Maya — thanks for the draft, and great timing. Putting Kimberly on this thread to help with co-sell ops and SKU/AMI questions.

Quick initial read (high level):
- Headline: lean toward benefit + metric where possible. Try "Reduce inference cost by up to Xx while preserving latency" vs feature-first phrasing. We can A/B headline variants in the listing.
- CTA: keep a single-primary CTA for Trial signups; secondary CTA should be "Request demo" not both equal-weight.
- Evidence: move customer ROI example and latency benchmarks higher (above the fold) — AWS co-sell likes tangible impact statements with a short footnote linking to the benchmark doc.
- Trial/PrivateOffer notes: recommend 14-day privateoffer trial for initial joins; reference SKU naming convention in attached sheet.

I created a quick tracked-change file with suggested copy swaps and a short checklist for marketplace readiness. See attached: initial_edits_v1.docx

Can we do a 30-min sync Thursday 7/15 at 10am PT or Friday 7/16 at 1pm PT? If those don't work, propose a couple times and we'll accommodate.

Action items I plan to drive after our call: finalize headline & three bullets optimized for conversion, confirm SKU/trial length with AWS PM, and prepare a co-sell one-pager for your field teams.

Cheers,
Irene Choi
Partner & Marketplace Operations, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

Attachment: initial_edits_v1.docx (tracked changes + readiness checklist)

Thanks everyone for the meeting earlier — productive and actionable. Summarizing agreed items and next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

1) Copy & hero finalization (Irene / Jonas)
   - Irene to deliver 3 headline variants optimized for trial conversion by 7/20 EOD.
   - Jonas to pick the preferred variant and confirm imagery.

2) Trial & SKUs (Tom / Kimberly / Acme)
   - AWS confirms 14-day privateoffer trial is fine for initial co-sell qualification; Tom to post final AMS checklist link in the thread.
   - Kimberly to map planned SKUs to Seller Portal constraints and return a final SKU naming list by 7/22.

3) Evidence & Benchmarks (Acme / Redwood)
   - Acme to provide the latency benchmark CSV and one-pager ROI case study by 7/23.
   - Redwood to fold the benchmark footnote into the product page and add a short linked appendix.

4) Field enablement & co-sell one-pager (Redwood)
   - Irene to produce a 1-page co-sell brief + one-slide demo script for Acme field by 7/26.

Attached artifacts (for tracking): final_product_page_copy_v3.docx; co-sell-playbook.pdf

Relevant links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcmeProductCopy (working copy), https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2026-REDWOOD-01
